subject: Handoff: Kilimanjaro AI MAP, RACI, and Kickoff Cadence
messages:
From: Ethan Park <ethan.park@redwood.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Lily Chen <lily.chen@kilimanjaro.ai>, Rajiv Kumar <rajiv@kilimanjaro.ai>
Cc: procurement@kilimanjaro.ai
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 15:22:00 -0800
Subject: Intro & MAP deliverables — Kilimanjaro AI (DEAL-9842)

Hi team —

Looping you all in for the customer success handoff for Kilimanjaro AI. They’ve agreed to proceed on the annual reserved plan; the commercial team (me) will stay involved until SOW is signed but this transitions to CSM-led delivery. Attached: Kilimanjaro-MAP-v1.2.pdf (mutual action plan) and a draft SOW.

High-level proposed milestones (from discovery):
- Week 0 (Kickoff): project alignment + access checklist
- Week 1–2: data connection & test inference runs (small pilot)
- Week 3–6: integration and tuning, KV/prefix caching enabled
- Week 7: internal validation, performance baseline
- Week 8: go-live / launch window

Proposed kickoff: Dec 7 or Dec 6 (flexible). Key risks called out in the MAP: procurement timeline for SOC2 addendum, and expected 3rd-party data store credentials.

Next steps for handoff: 
1) CSM to propose weekly onboarding cadence and RACI owners (owners for: enablement, infra, security sign-off, billing).
2) Implementation lead (Marissa) to confirm estimated engineering capacity and any blackout dates.
3) Customer to confirm procurement lead and preferred kickoff date.

Ethan
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
attachments: Kilimanjaro-MAP-v1.2.pdf, SOW-draft-Kilimanjaro.docx

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Ethan Park <ethan.park@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Lily Chen <lily.chen@kilimanjaro.ai>, Rajiv Kumar <rajiv@kilimanjaro.ai>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 09:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Intro & MAP deliverables — Kilimanjaro AI (DEAL-9842)

Thanks Ethan — I’ll take the lead on CSM/implementation coordination. I attached a RACI-cadence spreadsheet (raci-cadence-spreadsheet.xlsx) that maps owners to each milestone and proposes a weekly meeting cadence for the first 8 weeks.

Proposed onboarding cadence (first 6 weeks):
- Weekly 60-min sync (CSM, Eng lead, Customer PM) — progress, blockers, decisions
- Twice-weekly 30-min ops check (first 2 weeks) during data connection phase
- Dedicated tuning session week 3 (pairing session with customer engineers)

Draft RACI highlights (see sheet):
- Redwood infra enablement: Monica (owner), Marissa (support)
- Customer data access & creds: Customer (owner) — Rajiv / procurement contact
- Security review / SOC2 addendum: Soojin (owner), Security Eng (support)

I can run the kickoff agenda and own the master MAP document going forward. I’ll aim to schedule kickoff for Dec 6 at 10:00 AM PT unless customer prefers Dec 3 or Dec 7.

Action items assigned in this email:
- Rajiv / Lily: confirm procurement lead and procurement timeline (by EOD Friday)
- Marissa: flag any capacity constraints or blackout dates
- Ethan: confirm when you will send the signed SOW / DocuSign link to procurement

SoojIn Lee
Senior Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
Phone: (415) 555-0192
attachments: raci-cadence-spreadsheet.xlsx

From: Lily Chen <lily.chen@kilimanjaro.ai>

Date: Thu, 26 Nov 2026 11:17:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Intro & MAP deliverables — Kilimanjaro AI (DEAL-9842)

Thanks, Soojin — appreciate the clear plan. A few notes from our side:
- Procurement lead: CCing procurement@kilimanjaro.ai (this inbox manages SOW routing) and Rajiv is the internal PM.
- Preferred kickoff: earlier would be better for our sprint cadence. Can we target Dec 3 instead of Dec 6? That lets us include the Dec 6 sprint planning meeting internally.
- Technical question: for the pilot data export we’ll need a nightly batch window and an initial schema example. Can you confirm the export frequency you have in the MAP (I see a daily option listed)?

We’ll review the MAP and SOW this week — procurement usually needs 3 business days once we receive the DocuSign link.

Lily Chen
Head of Platform Integrations, Kilimanjaro AI
attachments: none

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Lily Chen <lily.chen@kilimanjaro.ai>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Ethan Park <ethan.park@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 27 Nov 2026 08:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Intro & MAP deliverables — Kilimanjaro AI (DEAL-9842)

Lily — thanks for the quick reply. Quoting your question below: 

> Can we target Dec 3 instead of Dec 6?

Dec 3 is tight for us — we have three engineering sprints that week with planned maintenance on Nov 30 that affects GPU availability. I can make Dec 6 at 10:00 AM PT work and allocate two engineers for the Week 1 data connection window. If the customer absolutely needs earlier, we can run a light kickoff (alignment only) on Dec 3 and reserve the technical deep-dive for Dec 6.

On the export cadence: the MAP shows a nightly batch by default; that was selected because it reduces per-token cost during the pilot. If you need a higher frequency we can support hourly deltas but it will require extra monitoring and may affect throughput profiles. Recommendation: start with nightly, prove model and caching, then move to increased cadence.

I’ve added a short runbook in our shared Confluence (https://confluence.redwood.com/display/KILIMANJARO/Onboarding-Runbook) with the Week 1 checklist and test endpoints.

Marissa Cole
Implementation Lead, Redwood Inference
